_readme: balderton.com/companies (WordPress; the company post type is hidden from the REST API and the sitemaps; FacetWP paging; the FacetWP refresh endpoint refuses a scripted call, "unable to auto-detect the post listing"). Read server-side page by page (GET /companies/?_paged=1..9, 24 cards per page, 205 rows, the first six cards on every page are the featured block and are deduplicated by anchor), 2026-09-26; raw pages under companies-raw/. Each card: name (h3 id = anchor), Live/Exited status class, location class and text, sector classes, one-line description, the firm's own round label "Seed in 2015" (split into stage_site + invest_year), the company website link and logo. There is no per-company page; url is the list anchor.
